decisions.rationale: Crag (moss, shape c): a low, wide ridge, built from overlapping convex blocks with moss on its upward facets and a talus of granite rubble blocks; 27.4 x 20.3 m and 11.3 m tall, 1,078 triangles, one flat-shaded kit mesh with baked AO; inside its round collider below 3 m and within 0.8 m above it (world-v3 circle footprint test).
limitations: Faceted low-poly blocks with sharp edges: no overhangs, caves, gullies or erosion detail.

decisions.rationale: In the Greenmarch, Hollowvale and Fenlands outcrops and the mountain ring along the Greenmarch, Hollowvale, Fenlands and Heartlands, at gameplay cameras (18-40 m, pitch 0.38-1.13): 11 m of rock dwarfs the soldier, captain and boss and closes the world's edge as a mountain ring with a far backdrop beyond it. A crag between the camera and the hero opens a 3.5-7 m cutaway cone (the hero fully visible behind a Frostspine crag in the wilds browser suite).
limitations: Seen through the cutaway, a crag shows its open inside faces; the ring's rock is a wall of crags, not climbable or walkable.
